title: The egress perimeter: what an address is, who may contract a host, and a malformed record refused in the reducer's own words
note: AUD-057 to AUD-059. An address is classified as what a connection to it reaches, and PUBLIC means globally reachable (NP1, NP2). A contract for a host is put in force only by an egress issuer over every host it claims, and one host is decided by one contract, in the primary (NP3 to NP8) and the second reader (NP9 to NP11). The reducer refuses a malformed grant, revocation or service record in its own words (NP12 to NP14). tests/test_egress_perimeter.py holds each.

mutations.name: NP1_a_mapped_address_is_classified_by_its_ipv6_flags
mutations.rationale: ::ffff:127.0.0.1 reads as PRIVATE, and a grant permitting private ranges reaches loopback

mutations.name: NP2_shared_address_space_is_public
mutations.rationale: a grant permitting PUBLIC only reaches 100.64.0.0/10, an inside network, at the decision and at the socket

mutations.name: NP3_replay_takes_an_overlapping_contract
mutations.rationale: a history holding a second contract for a contracted host loads, and the one sorting first decides

mutations.name: NP4_a_writer_writes_an_overlapping_contract
mutations.rationale: a wider contract under a name that sorts first is written over a contracted host, and lifts its operations and budget

mutations.name: NP5_replay_takes_a_contract_from_anyone
mutations.rationale: a contract written by an actor holding no egress authority over its hosts is in force on replay

mutations.name: NP6_a_writer_writes_a_contract_for_anyone
mutations.rationale: an actor holding no egress authority over a host puts a contract for it in force

mutations.name: NP7_wildcards_overlap_only_when_identical
mutations.rationale: *.example.org and *.api.example.org both claim x.api.example.org, and both contracts are put in force

mutations.name: NP10_the_second_reader_takes_an_overlapping_contract
mutations.rationale: the second reader holds two contracts for one host, and reports nothing

mutations.name: NP11_the_second_reader_overlaps_wildcards_only_when_identical
mutations.rationale: the second reader reads *.example.org and *.api.example.org as claiming different hosts
